facts.value: The Department maintains partnerships with leading universities worldwide. In order to strengthen its international profile and utilize common focuses, two universities have been selected as strategic partners. The collaboration includes, among other things, research partnerships, exchanges of teaching staff and students, joint study programs, doctoral seminars, and scientific conferences.
